name: member_admin_groups
description: R158.100 (2026-10-13) - Member Server local admin group membership. Get-LocalGroupMember for 3 local groups (BUILTIN\Administrators + Remote Desktop Users + Power Users), 跟 ad_admin_members 1.0.1 1:1 平行, 但 0 AD RSAT 走 Microsoft.PowerShell.LocalAccounts (PSR 5.1+ in-box, member-server 全装). Public-table mode (跟 R158.78 / R158.86 precedent 1:1): manifest omits `database` block → runner.js post-hook 直接 MERGE dedup on (hostname, group_name, member_sid) 跨 re-run. 24h cadence 跟 ad_admin_members 1:1 (admin 变更不频繁). Wire shape: { metrics: { agent_id, hostname, collected_at, groups: [{ name, members: [{ sid, name, class, principal_source, is_enabled, display_name }] }], error_code } }. agent.type='non-ad' → SCOPE_OVERRIDE 白名单必挂 (R158.86.5 强 invariant).
